items.title: French AI boom exposes Europe’s funding gap as startups turn to U.S.
items.summary: Investing.com -- France is producing a growing number of high-value artificial intelligence and technology companies, but their success is also highlighting Europe’s shortage of late-stage capital compared with the U.S., according to Bloomberg.
